To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

impedance microbiology, by mean of Modified Gompertz curve, is a valid method for predicting acidifying performances of lactic acid bacteria and, therefore, it can be applied to starter selection in milk transformation.

impedance microbiology is a fast and easy to use method that allows evaluating potential acidifying performances and, consequently, the technological performances of starter latic acid bacteria to employ in milk transformation.
impedance microbiology is a valid tool for evaluating the potential acidifying performance of lactic acid bacteria starter cultures.
In summary, our research is concerned with
finding a way to evaluate the potential of a starter culture to acidify milk and to propose it as a useful tool for the dairy industry.
the possibility of using the impedance microbiology to evaluate the acidifying performance of lactic acid bacteria starter cultures in milk.
the possibility to exploit the kinetics parameters of Gompertz equation as an objective approach to evaluate the acidification performances of LAB in milk.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the impedance microbiology can be used for a fast and objective way to evaluate the potential metabolic acidifying performances of a strain to be used as starter in milk transformation.

, in order to have a better understanding of the potential acidifying performance of a strain, the kinetic parameters, calculated from the impedance curve, are the most reliable parameters to be taken in account.
impedance microbiology is a valid tool to be used in the food industry, especially for quality control and for the evaluation of potential acidifying performances.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
impedance microbiology can be used to evaluate the potential metabolic performances of lactic acid bacteria, in terms of acidifying performances, in a simple, objective, fast, and inexpensive way.
impedance microbiology, when properly applied, can be a valid tool to evaluate potential acidifying performances in milk transformation.
impedance microbiology is a useful tool to evaluate the metabolic activity of lactic acid bacteria and to predict their performances in milk transformation.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of impedance microbiology, in association with Gompertz kinetics, could represent a valuable tool in the evaluation of the potential acidifying performance of lactic acid bacteria starter cultures.

the impedance microbiology can be used for the evaluation of acidification performances of lactic acid bacteria starter cultures to be employed in dairy transformation, and that the kinetics parameters, λ, μmax and Yend, can be used to describe the acidification performances of starter cultures.
the use of kinetics parameters, derived from the Gompertz model, can be a valid approach to objectively evaluate the acidifying potential of starter cultures in milk.
